title: First Light — imported pine forest
modifications: Three artist-authored LOD2 pine variants extracted. Trunks and major boughs reduced; crowns sampled from the imported geometry and represented by crossed photographic twig cards for mobile rendering. Original RGB preserved while packing opacity; textures resized to at most 1024px and encoded as WebP quality 88. Trees scaled for tactical readability. Exported as GLB. This is a game LOD, not full-resolution photogrammetry.

additionalAssets.title: Fern 02
additionalAssets.modifications: Original four glTF variants repackaged as GLB and instanced with varied size and rotation.

props: props.json records the existing scans and their mobile reductions; original campaign assets remain unchanged.
note: Environment art, not a surveyed reconstruction of Tuchola Forest. Game self-hosts the assets and does not call the Poly Haven API.
